## Changes

- Support secret build arguments from app build config.
- Forward secret build args from matching CI environment variables instead of storing values in the local CI config.
- Redact secret build arg values from Docker build output.
- Avoid logging build arg values in debug output.
- Add tests for secret build arg forwarding and missing secret env vars.

## Validation

- `go test ./cmd/wodby/ci/build ./pkg/docker ./pkg/types`
